plan.name: primary_risk_optimization_v2
plan.cohort: Same 4068 eligible participants; no data removed based on outcomes or test metrics
plan.selection: Only 2021-2022, stratified group 3-fold CV by year-PSU; fold-internal early stopping; refit outer train before evaluation
plan.calibration: Original 2023 calibration subset; primary and conditional temperatures independently fit
plan.threshold: Original 2023 threshold subset, Youden and sensitivity90
plan.test: Original already-inspected 2024; exploratory final evaluation, never used for selection
plan.preprocessing: Train-only medians, means/scales, optional hinge quartiles; explicit missing indicators and categorical missing levels
plan.objective: Primary binary BCE + 0.10 conditional positive-pattern CE; one-pass coherent joint output
plan.selection_metric: Mean fold survey-weighted ROC-AUC (Brier as tie-break); no test-based seed or winner selection
plan.latency: Benchmark optimized NN and optimized LR through identical validation/feature/output paths; also preserve old runtime comparison

nn_config.name: optimized_v2
nn_config.architecture: logistic skip + tanh hidden residual; primary risk and conditional 15-pattern output

caveat: 2024 is a reused exploratory holdout. Tuning uses only pre-2023 data. New models use 2052 development rows vs old model 1680; matched LR uses 2052 too.
